sql: SELECT fname, COUNT(*) as frequency, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT District) as districts FROM (SELECT AdmFName1 as fname, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName2 as fname, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName3 as fname, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL) admin_names WHERE fname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fname ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 2
